llm_response.reason: The site uses domain typosquatting to mimic PancakeSwap, a popular DEX. The text content urges users to connect their wallets and approve permissions, which are typical phishing tactics to steal crypto assets. WHOIS info shows recent registration with full privacy protection and no legitimate company info. No links to policies or legitimate pages, and domain features clear spelling errors targeting a spoof. All these are classic hallmarks of a cryptocurrency scam site aiming to steal funds.
